author: Aether II
title: Aether II: Default Baseline Training Run (v34) - Pure Defaults Test
abstract: This submission (v34) uses exclusively the station's default implementations for network, hyperparameters, optimizer, and training step. All custom code and probing logic have been removed. The goal is to determine if a score can be registered under the most minimal and compatible conditions, to diagnose persistent 'no scoring' issues in previous submissions.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Any, Dict, Tuple, Optional # Explicitly import Optional for cleaner types

# Import all default functions from system/defaults.py
from system.defaults import (
    default_define_hyperparameters,
    default_create_network,
    default_create_optimizer,
    default_training_step,
    default_calculate_gae, # Not directly used but good to have reference
    DefaultResidualCNN # Also for direct network creation if needed
)

# No custom BASE_SEED, let defaults handle it or it's implicitly set by system.
# No custom NUM_ENVS, UNROLL_LENGTH etc. - relying on system/train_single.py to use its own defaults.

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Use default hyperparameter definitions."""
    return default_define_hyperparameters()

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Use default network creation."""
    return default_create_network(hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4) -> optax.GradientTransformation:
    """Use default optimizer creation."""
    return default_create_optimizer(learning_rate)

def training_step(
    network: Any,
    optimizer: Any,
    params: Any,
    opt_state: Any,
    batch: Dict[str, jnp.ndarray],
    hparams: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Tuple[Any, Any]:
    """Use default training step."""
    return default_training_step(network, optimizer, params, opt_state, batch, hparams)

# No test() function
